length limits enforced (hero title > 120 chars)
max-items limit enforced (13 feature cards)
wrong types / non-object body rejected, never 500

product detail by slug; unknown slug -> 404 envelope
storefront never exposes unpublished/draft products or cost price
categories, banners, theme and menus endpoints serve for the tenant
cart: create requires storeId; unknown cart id -> 404/409, not 500
cart add / update / remove item round trip
cart rejects invalid quantities and foreign product ids
cart is isolated by tenant host (cannot be read through another tenant host)
checkout pricing returns consistent money breakdown (total = subtotal - discount + shipping + tax)
order validation: missing address / bad gateway / empty cart rejected
placing an order without an Idempotency-Key is rejected (400)
COD order placement succeeds, decrements/reserves stock, and is visible to the owning merchant only
cart is emptied/consumed after order and cannot be reused to double-order
merchant can cancel the QA order and stock is released (cleanup/restore)
coupon applies to cart and invalid coupon is rejected
gift card balance check returns balance for a valid code and valid:false otherwise
GET /storefront/theme for the seeded tenant (INFO: 404 means no row in tenant_themes; theme-assignment still serves)
cannot order more than available stock (oversell guard)
customer account endpoints require a storefront token
a merchant JWT is not accepted as a storefront customer token
every error response uses the {success:false,error:{code,message},meta} envelope with a correlation id
unknown route returns a JSON 404, not an HTML/stack page
list endpoints honour pagination limits and reject out-of-range values
malformed JSON body -> 4xx (not 500)
oversized body is rejected (not accepted/500)
security headers present on API responses (nosniff, no X-Powered-By)
CORS: a hostile origin is not reflected / credentialed

SQL injection in login email/password does not authenticate or 500
SQL injection in filter/sort params on console list is inert
error responses do not leak stack traces, SQL or file paths
internal entity names are not exposed in client-facing error messages
IDOR: one merchant cannot revoke another user's session
JWKS publishes only public key material

mass assignment: client-supplied tenantId / role fields are ignored on update

tests.title: applied migrations match the migration files on disk (no pending / unknown)
every tenant-scoped table has a NOT NULL tenant_id except the documented nullable ones
cross-tenant referential consistency: child rows belong to the same tenant as their parent
no orphan rows for key relations (FK integrity)
unique constraints hold: no duplicate (tenant, SKU) among live products, no duplicate order numbers
inventory invariants: on_hand >= 0, reserved >= 0, available = on_hand - reserved, reserved <= on_hand
order money: total = subtotal - discount + shipping + tax + cod_fee (+ round_off) for every order
reservation ledger consistency: reserved quantity equals open allocations of non-cancelled, unfulfilled orders (informational drift check)
soft deletion: soft-deleted products are absent from public API and live listings
passwords are stored hashed (bcrypt) and no plaintext demo password is in the users table
schema drift between TypeORM entities and live schema (informational; migrations are hand-written)
seeded SIMPLE products must have inventory at the product level (variant_id NULL) so they can be purchased
